visibility.truthIncluded: false for public stochastic exports unless explicitly included
visibility.hiddenTruthChecksum: non-cryptographic checksum of omitted truth for identity/debugging
visibility.warning: browser hidden truth is cheat-resistant only, not secure

replaySeedContract.challengeId: stable UUID / challenge instance id used as the replay seed anchor
replaySeedContract.replaySeedAnchor: same value as challengeId for deterministic seed derivation
replaySeedContract.generationVersion: generator compatibility version such as anchor-generator-v1
replaySeedContract.generationConfig: normalized config required for deterministic regeneration
replaySeedContract.derivedSeeds: namespace-specific deterministic seeds for terrain, currents, roi, hazards, depth, targets, forecast, truth, and mission

exactReplay: available when a saved challenge snapshot exists, or when UUID + generationConfig + compatible generationVersion + derivedSeeds permit deterministic regeneration
notes: anchor.challenge is the replayable game import format. It combines level, mission, rules, identity, visible planning data, and stochastic visibility metadata. Deterministic challenges may include truth plainly. Public stochastic challenges omit plain hidden truth; an optional opaque bundle is for reload convenience only and is not secure.
